browser.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production-quality Korean mobile UI mockup for the existing Sobrita savings app, continuing the supplied visual references. This is one screen of a chosen sequential workflow, NOT an alternative design direction. Target viewport 390 x 844, output at a high resolution with exactly the same 390:844 aspect ratio. App content only, edge-to-edge rectangular canvas. No phone/device bezel, OS status bar, notch, OS clock, battery, external browser chrome, perspective, or mockup background. Preserve the existing Sobrita references' warm white surface, strong dark navy text #12265B, thin square navy outlined inputs, teal #009C98 labels and solid teal primary buttons outlined navy, generously spaced Korean typography, and tiny charming pixel coin-jar decoration only where specified. Actual text must be crisp, correctly spelled Korean and legible at mobile size. Body 14-16px equivalent; headings 22-26px; one primary action. Do not redesign with coral, purple, gradients, giant cards or pill-shaped everything. Current date anchor 2026-11-09, Mexico City; do not invent a dated promotional event. Currency MX$ throughout. Price 1699 is an example copied from an observed product page before size selection, not a guaranteed final purchase price. Do not add technical words like API, WebView, OCR, parsing, prototype, or implementation disclaimers inside the UI. No guarantees, bank transfer actions, loans or purchase completion. No home dashboard or new navigation tabs. This concept is a mockup, not a claim that Android integration is already implemented.
INPUT REFERENCES: The recent Mercado Libre browser screenshot supplies the black adidas sneaker with white stripes, retailer yellow header and actual product-page visual context. The recent two tall Korean Sobrita mockups supply the app branding, typography, navy/teal controls and spacing. Transform those references into a single Korean-language in-app product browser screen.
COMPOSITION:
Top 0-100px: Sobrita-owned warm-white app bar with back arrow, title "상품 확인", close X on the right. Below, a small lock and "mercadolibre.com.mx" with small text "외부 쇼핑몰".
Middle 100-680px: a real-looking scrollable Mercado Libre product page visually DISTINCT from Sobrita controls. Short yellow retailer header with "mercado libre". A large clean catalog photo of the SAME black low-top adidas running sneaker with three white side stripes and thick white sole, left-side profile on pale gray-white background. Keep product photo natural, not cartoon. Below image: "아디다스 러닝화 JQ8645", large "MX$1,699", a simple separated row "사이즈" and selection "선택", and small link "배송·옵션 확인". Render this retailer content in Korean as a design explanation; no Spanish prose except brand/domain. Product details remain comfortably above the fixed footer. No shopping cart, no quantity selector, no installment amount, no actual buy button in the visible crop.
Bottom fixed Sobrita footer, white with a thin navy top divider, distinctly outside the retail page: small "Sobrita 저축 목표", full-width teal rectangular primary button "이 상품으로 목표 만들기", then small muted helper "확인한 상품을 저축 목표로 저장해요." This is the focal action. Button and helper fit in bottom safe padding without device home indicator.
No additional steps/screens in this image; no side-by-side panels, arrows, captions outside canvas or annotations.
